answers.reason: The elected student representative holds no office that grants a seat in the senate.
Budget planning is handled at a higher level involving office holders, excluding the student representative.
The appointment committee is not a body where the student representative has a regulated seat.
The elected student representative has a seat to speak for students in faculty matters.
The regulations provide student participation in study and teaching matters.
The examination board decides on individual student matters without general student representative seats.
Internal research funding is restricted to researchers and higher office holders.
Module revisions are handled by faculty staff rather than the student representative.
Laboratory equipment procurement is managed by designated staff and researchers.
Orientation week planning directly concerns students and involves student representatives.
